in_chain_replicate.role: THE COMPARATOR the allowance prescribes and the in-chain replicate the delta is read at

boundary: A milestone read on the signed test sample. No utterance text, transcript, gold label string or model output is printed or persisted: ids, counts, rates and hashes only.

read_driver.refusal: the driver refuses before any score is opened unless this READ row is root countersigned
read_driver.strata_source: scorer: post-stratification by gold intent INSIDE the official-scoring step (--strata-inside-scorer), aggregates only; see registered-facts-v1.json post_stratification_read

steps: 1. Refuse unless BOTH manifests are COMPLETE at 3,010 rows with this registration's composed config hashes (as re-pinned at the flip), sealed, each with one successful complete official slurp-slu-official-test score, and unless the READ row is root countersigned.

2. THE DELIVERY CHECK (gold-free): each cell's flown first-phase boundary selections equal its own prepared supply. A mismatch is an engineering defect, is reported, and consumes the milestone (no re-fly).

3. Primary: intent accuracy paired per recording, prompt-clustered, 10,000 draws, seed 20260929. Guard: official pooled SLU-F1. Apply the protocol's rule at the fallback null h_intent 1.3329 / h_SLU 1.4492 (recording-scaled beside it: 0.664 / 0.7219) against the declared expected_effect_pp.
4. Intent and SLU reported SEPARATELY, each in both weightings, with per-intent and per-scenario tables and the recording-channel split (headset / far-field).
5. Entity FP / TP / FN against MILESTONE-SUCCESSOR1-PLAN with the zero-gold-row emission count.
6. Write the read under its own id; every number is a MILESTONE development number (owner decisions 28 and 151), never a test claim.
title: Test-sample MILESTONE-SUCCESSOR1-COMP1B -- COMP-1b against MILESTONE-SUCCESSOR1-PLAN (the locked system) on SLURP-TEST-SAMPLE-3010-V1

weightings.driver_gap: Resolved in shared stage3_paired_read and scoring_strata. This recipe requires --strata-source scorer and --weighting post-stratified; retain aggregate-only output.
weightings.equal_stratum: 1/58 over the intents present in the sample
weightings.natural_mixture: POST-STRATIFIED: per-intent accuracy weighted by the full-test per-intent shares of the roster receipt docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-test-sample-3010-v1.json (weightings block); the raw roster mean is NOT the natural-mixture number (design note section 5)
weightings.post_stratification: 58 strata carried of 59 counted; intent = sum_h w_h * mean_h, SLU-F1 = F1 of the w_h-weighted per-row-normalised TP/FP/FN totals; computed and bootstrapped (10,000 draws, seed 20260929, prompt clusters within strata) inside the scorer process, which writes one aggregate receipt and never a per-row stratum
